reauth.no_password_notice: This account has no password. Select Continue verification to verify your identity with a method available to this account, such as a code sent to your sign-up email.
reauth.unavailable: This account cannot receive a verification code at its sign-up email. If Continue verification does not work either, please contact the administrator.

change_password.first_time_notice: You are setting a password for the first time. Enter only the new password.
change_password.reauth_unavailable: This account cannot receive the verification email at its sign-up address, so a password cannot be set. Please contact the administrator.
change_password.reauth_other: This account cannot receive the verification email at its sign-up address. When you save the new password, you will verify your identity with another method available to this account (such as signing in again with your company account).
